comparison.objective: Turn over a taped carton, cut its bottom seam and end folds, open four flaps, and collapse the intact carton flat; candidate instead sifts ceramic media from retained steel washers and reseats the screen.
comparison.physical_skill: Carton turnover, guarded cutting, outward flap articulation, and structural collapse versus two-tab grasping, shared-load screen orientation, force-limited agitation, selective passage, and precise two-support replacement.
comparison.success_condition: Record requires measured upright-to-inverted turnover, complete cut coverage, all bottom flaps opened ≥150°, eight flaps coplanar within 15°, a ≤24 mm flat slab, and a 1 s clear-hand hold; candidate grades recovered mass and washer retention plus supported release for 3 s. No material rubric detail is missing.
comparison.reason: Although both involve bimanual orientation control, the record tests cutting and articulated carton flattening, not size-selective many-body separation through apertures.
